email.subject: Arctic Group's site on phones
email.body:
Hi Aisha,

I looked at Arctic Group's website. Two things are likely costing you calls: it doesn't render properly on mobile, and the pages are slow to load because of oversized images. Most people search for HVAC help on their phone when something's broken, and if the site is hard to use or slow, they just call the next company.

Also noticed the footer still shows an old copyright year, which makes the site look unmaintained.

I'm Alex, I run a small shop that fixes exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing what's happening and what it'd take to fix. No obligation either way.

Alex
